SavedItem.title: SavedItem
SavedItem.description: A saved legal research item such as a statute, precedent, AI analysis, drafted pleading, or citation snippet.

id.description: Unique identifier for the saved research item.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this research item.

type.description: Category of the saved research entry.

citation.description: Formal Pennsylvania or federal statutory/case citation.

notes.description: Private attorney, paralegal, or client case notes.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the item was saved.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the item was last updated.

LegalMatter.title: LegalMatter
LegalMatter.description: A case file or legal matter dossier organized by client and county court jurisdiction.

userId.description: The UID of the owning practitioner or litigant.

clientName.description: Name of the client or party represented.

county.description: Pennsylvania County Court of Common Pleas venue.

docketNumber.description: Prothonotary or clerk docket number if assigned.

category.description: Legal practice area (e.g., Custody, Truancy, Torts, Support).

notes.description: Case notes, factual chronology, and trial preparation thoughts.

WorkspaceExport.title: WorkspaceExport
WorkspaceExport.description: A record of an item exported or synchronized with Google Workspace APIs.

RecentSearch.title: RecentSearch
RecentSearch.description: A recent statute search query or viewed statute topic.

id.description: Unique identifier for the search history entry.

userId.description: The UID of the user or session owner.

query.description: The search query string or topic searched.

statuteId.description: Optional specific statute ID matched or selected.

statuteCitation.description: Statute citation if a specific statute was clicked or matched.

searchedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the search was performed.

/users/{userId}/savedItems/{itemId}.description: User's bookmarked statutes, legal precedents, drafted pleadings, and research reports.

/users/{userId}/matters/{matterId}.description: User's organized legal matter files and case dockets.

/users/{userId}/workspaceExports/{export.description: History of documents and tasks synchronized to Google Drive, Docs, Tasks, Chat, Forms, or Meet.

/users/{userId}/recentSearches/{searchId.description: User's last 5 searched statutes and queries for rapid revisit.
